messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm assembling a short rollup for the routing fallback change we shipped. Need: 2–3 sentence blurb for what's new, one migration note for SDK users, and a known-issue callout about stream duplication. Release window is tomorrow AM.
chris: Posted a draft PR with the blurb + example. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 (see \`docs/releases/routing-fallback.md\`).
jordan: I can handle the migration snippet. Quick note: when fallback kicks in we change model variant mid-stream which can duplicate a trailing token in rare cases. Seen in staging with the sample below.
jordan: ```
STREAM LOG:
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z request id=abc123 fallback->variantB tokens: "... for the"
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z request id=abc123 variantB resumed tokens: " the final"
RESULT: duplicated " the"
```
andre: Ugh, good catch. We should recommend upgrading SDK to the new streaming client (v0.11.2) which dedups on reconnection. Also add a short snippet showing how to opt into non-resumable fallback if you prefer no duplication but slightly higher latency.
maria: @chris can you add the SDK upgrade line and the non-resumable example? Keep it tiny — one code block and one sentence.
chris: Yep. Added this snippet to the PR:
```python
# prefer no-resume fallback to avoid duplicated tokens
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(stream_resume=False)
resp = client.chat.stream(... )
```
chris: Also added a one-line known-issue pill: "Streaming may emit duplicated tokens when routing fallback occurs; upgrade to SDK >= 0.11.2 or use non-resume mode."
docs-ci: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-1234--docs.redwood.ai — includes the PR changes and the SDK snippet. (rendered: /releases/routing-fallback) :white_check_mark:
maria: Looks good in the preview, thanks. @jordan can you sanity-check the duplication log text and confirm wording?
jordan: wording is fine. Suggest adding "rare" and an estimate: affects <0.5% of routed requests in our tests. Added a parenthetical to PR.
andre: One more ask: please add a short developer-facing example showing how to detect fallback events in the response metadata so customers can instrument. Small JSON example should be OK.
maria: Good idea. Keep it 2 lines max. @chris can you append?
chris: Added this JSON snippet to the PR under "examples":
```json
{"event":"fallback","from":"variantA","to":"variantB","reason":"capacity"}
```
chris: Also updated the changelog entry to a single sentence summary for the release notes page.
maria: Great. Can everyone react with :shipit: or comment by EOD? I want to merge and cut the site deploy by 7:30am tomorrow.
jordan: :shipit:
andre: :shipit: small nits addressed in PR comments
chris: Done — merging after docs-ci green.
docs-ci: CI green. Preview link same: https://deploy-preview-1234--docs.redwood.ai. Auto-redirects and anchor links checked.
maria: Merged. Thanks all — I'll add the release note to the internal release checklist and flag it for the product announcement thread.
chris: Noting follow-up: open an issues doc to track any post-release customer reports and add a short troubleshooting Q&A in the docs if we see more than 5 tickets.
maria: Will do. Closing thread. :wave:
